# Filters available in the shipped LGPL FFmpeg 8.1.3 (engine-bin) that
# CreatorClips's graphs use or may reasonably use. test_ffmpeg_filters.py checks
# every emitted filter against this list without needing FFmpeg, and checks
# this list against `engine-bin/ffmpeg -hide_banner -filters` when staged.
# Add a name only after confirming it in that output. GPL-only filters
# (perspective, boxblur, eq, ...) and drawtext (no libfreetype build) are absent.
